These files are exact UTF-8 copies from Devansh-Ojha/ttir2linalg,
branch results/flash-attention-2026-10-29, pinned to commit
4ac9ccb512057a4472c7bd0e4b9864cbab99f657.

`source.json` records the repository path, Git blob SHA and SHA256 for every
copied file. `README.md` in this directory describes fixture provenance;
the original results README is saved as `RESULTS.md` to avoid ambiguity.
All seven TTIR files retain their original content, names, compiler locations
and attributes. They were not regenerated, normalized or handwritten.

The capture reports describe GPU execution on Graham's RTX 5060 laptop GPU,
Triton 3.9.0 and PyTorch 2.15.0+cu132. These reports are evidence of that run,
not a claim that GPU capture was repeated locally. Their absolute paths refer
to Graham's machine; tests use the local fixture paths from the manifest.
